limitations: Static call sites and reviewed domain membership, not a complete runtime graph.
Mount middleware, computed references, SQL effects, external systems and production state require manual verification.
Candidate tests are not proof of sufficient coverage.
Browser-event links match literal names on window/document only, one hop; computed names, aliases, bubbling, CSS selectors, React context semantics and live state need manual review.

domains.label: Identity, sessions and authorization
domains.reason: Verified token → server session → current durable profile → route authorization. Browser roles are display state; never authority.

domains.label: Payment and paid access
domains.reason: Create, webhook, verify, recover and claim must agree on owner, plan, amount/currency and exactly-once durable grant. Profile edits must preserve paid rights.

domains.label: Trial, free demo and AI quota
domains.reason: Trial duration and paid-vs-trial labels cross backend, client and copy. Quota consumption and rollback must survive races and restart; reset boundaries use IST.

domains.label: AI providers and documents
domains.reason: Authenticated request → quota → allowlisted document fetch → provider budget/fallback → response/cache. Retrieved documents are untrusted content, not instructions.

domains.label: Filings, watchlists and alert delivery
domains.reason: Poll → normalize/dedupe → persistence → feed and alert decisions → recipient-specific delivery/inbox. Global and personal recipients must remain distinct. Preset saves replace stable per-owner IDs atomically; confirmed cloud settings feed every poll. Personal channels supersede inherited defaults once presets are saved. Live polling has a CRON_SECRET bearer-protected HTTP trigger, a 60-second in-container watchdog timer, a continuous 15-second active poller, and a 15-second-stale traffic trigger. The shared process-local monitor lock skips running cycles without queueing. Request lifetime covers bounded ingestion/write drain; cron source failure eligibility is capped at 60 seconds. External Scheduler remains necessary for idle request-based Cloud Run; legacy cron returns 410. Numbered IST worker summaries and cron request summaries have distinct event fields.

domains.label: Notes, preferences and notification inbox
domains.reason: Verified UID must constrain every read/write/delete. Delayed saves must not resurrect deleted data or overwrite newer preferences; inbox clear/read must be durable.

domains.label: Persistence and recovery
domains.reason: Supabase and privileged RPCs are server-only. Cache/fallback behavior varies per DAO: local success never proves durable payment success. Review migrations with caller changes.

domains.label: Public pages, routing and cache
domains.reason: API responses, SSR routes, browser deep links, SEO and service-worker caching must remain compatible. User-specific responses must never enter shared public caches.

domains.label: Referral code, commission and pricing
domains.reason: Verified UID owns immutable unique code aliases. Application creates a private pending intent; checkout snapshots attribution and reward mode; a paid-grant trigger settles the unique reward transactionally. SSE carries owner-only snapshots with reconciliation. See rule/REFERRALS.md for legacy cutover requirements.

domains.label: Market data, results, news and stories
domains.reason: Upstream timestamps, stock identity and market sessions affect cached API results, screen freshness and alert timing. Public market data availability does not establish trading-data accuracy.

domains.label: FAQ, search and public discovery
domains.reason: Public copy and crawler metadata must agree with actual API/product contracts. Admin SEO mutations inherit mount guards; generated summaries are not evidence of source accuracy.

domains.label: Startup, abuse controls and diagnostics
domains.reason: Startup and settings influence background jobs, provider calls, abuse limits and logs. A live HTTP listener does not establish that durable stores or external providers are ready. Poller stage deadlines release the monitor lock without resuming abandoned workers; dedicated local poller history is not cloud deployment durability.

domains.label: Frontend: routes, tabs and scroll
domains.reason: URL and active tab must agree across direct links, refresh, browser Back/Forward and share pages. Loading, focus and scroll restoration are part of navigation; route tests do not prove browser behavior.

domains.label: Frontend: identity and saved preferences
domains.reason: Guest, restoring, signed-in and expired states must stay distinct. Late requests and saved preferences must not overwrite newer edits or leak between accounts. A success message requires the appropriate confirmed result.

domains.label: Frontend: shared styling, motion and overlays
domains.reason: Global CSS, inherited theme tokens, shared controls, focus, z-index and scroll locks connect screens without direct imports. Review all changed selector/token consumers; this seed list is not every affected screen. No browser accessibility or screenshot test suite is established by this domain.

domains.label: Frontend: feed, watchlists, results and detail
domains.reason: List/detail identity, filters, watchlist membership, badge counts and timestamps must agree. Background refresh preserves content, density, selection and scroll. Rapid filter changes must not render older responses.

domains.label: Frontend: note editor, saved list and counts
domains.reason: Editor writes dispatch notes-changed; saved-list and Settings listeners refresh independently. Preserve draft, list and count consistency across save, edit, delete, retry, account change and overlay close. API tests do not establish DOM focus or draft behavior.

domains.label: Frontend: pricing, checkout, receipt and referral
domains.reason: Displayed amount, checkout attribution, return verification, receipt/history and subscription display share one contract. Pending referral, confirmed reward and stale stream are different UI states. Never turn a redirect or unconfirmed write into success.

domains.label: Frontend: AI request, quota and saved output
domains.reason: AI request lifecycle connects quota meters, upgrade entry points, cancellation and saving generated content. Failed/aborted requests, late responses, quota events and account changes must keep all consumers consistent.

domains.label: Frontend: connectivity, offline cache and consent
domains.reason: Network events affect banners and retry state; service-worker cache differs from request success. Consent and push permission have separate lifecycles. Review cached user data on logout/account switch and avoid duplicate listeners or delivery.

domains.label: Frontend: landing and public content
domains.reason: Public links, pricing claims, server-rendered content and client views must agree. Lazy navigation, responsive composition, keyboard operation and motion require browser evidence beyond server discovery tests.

domains.label: Document startup, framing and monitoring
domains.reason: Canonical document headers preserve OAuth popups, AI Studio preview and public embeds. Deferred optional SDKs preserve authentication assessment, configured monitoring and explicit push requests without blocking public paint.

domains.label: Impact Radar events and personal tracking
domains.reason: Two Home previews open a native modal Radar dashboard and immediate detail. Watchlist scope stays separate from durable event follows. Both exchange disclosures and shared RSS intake carry source/date provenance; explicit jurisdiction/case references alone may join evidence. Future events have no predictions. Observed NSE final daily closes are a separate bounded, cached read with per-session source, missing-data states and no causal attribution. Account cancellation, modal focus/scroll, themes and reduced motion remain explicit contracts. The list is read-only; existing watchdog drives bounded intake. Server-only DB categories, strict real company identity, typed proceedings, source-domain rules and offset timestamps gate publishing. Reviewed PNC source backfill retains explicit news timestamps and separately sourced NSE daily ranges. Following outages preserve closed records. Additional material event terms come from private DB rules and match bounded literal phrases independently of source type or authority. Explicit RSS timestamps normalize to UTC. Publisher/report attribution and related-topic links preserve uncertainty. Selected company final NSE session values persist as small, private, duplicate-safe snapshots and can survive upstream outages. Routine corporate transactions and statutory takeover boilerplate are excluded independently of configured discovery terms. Insolvency/disputes retain the stable deals category ID with a focused label. Read projections hide legacy routine/vague cards while retaining immutable evidence and follows; all headings use source wording and original timeline titles remain intact.
